title: אייל זהב
summary: העיניים והפנים של היוצרת זוהרים בסדקי זהב עד שהיא הופכת לאייל מלכותי עם קרניים מוזהבות ביער מואר.

phases.what: Golden lightning cracks spread across cheeks and neck.
Antlers, deer ears, and golden armor with a chest crystal grow on her.
She fully transforms into a majestic golden stag standing in a glowing forest stream.
A bright golden fire explosion fills the screen, transitioning to a close-up of the stag.
Camera pulls back as the stag walks forward through the stream, ending in a bright light burst.

remix.prompt: The person in the image is live-streaming at home and their eyes suddenly glow bright golden-orange. Glowing golden cracks spread across their cheeks and neck while keeping the person recognizable until the full transformation covers the face. Golden antlers, deer ears, and ornate golden armor with a bright diamond chest crystal sprout from their body. The camera pulls back as they fully transform into a majestic golden stag with glowing leaf-covered antlers standing in a dark enchanted forest stream under golden light beams. A fiery golden explosion transitions to a close-up of the stag's face with glowing eyes and forehead crystal, before it walks forward in radiant golden lighting, vertical framing.
